utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could really use a few helping hands. If you’re free, I’d appreciate it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’m happy to spread the word and send a few neighbors your way. Saturday at the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll spread the word and see who can help on Saturday at the front porch. Tell me what kind of help you need most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help at the front porch this Saturday, and the biggest need is probably a few more hands to sort and carry things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help on Saturday. Just tell me what you want me to do at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a big help. Could you come by at 9:30 and help sort tools and keep an eye on the sign-in sheet on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help at the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help, Mina. What time on Saturday should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help out at the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m putting it together this Saturday at the front porch and could use a few helpers. If you know anyone willing, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can help out. What time on Saturday are you starting at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to start at 10 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I can help set it up on Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli. I’ll send you the setup list and a few easy things to bring before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still lining up the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, and I could use a couple of helpers to keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good, Pia. I’m free Saturday and I can help at the front porch.
